capabilities: Export folders or single files as a package
Include image attachments in the export
Embed linked content into the output
Write output as GitHub Flavored Markdown or HTML
Set an absolute output path outside the vault
extras: README notes that output outside the vault requires an OS absolute path and that asset paths must be relative to the markdown output folder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to export a note or folder as a self-contained package with its embedded images and assets.
summary: Markdown export plugin that packages notes with their image attachments for export in Markdown or HTML format.
